# SupContrast

The SimCLR architecture in `models.py` and the loss and training utilities in
`train.py` are adapted from [SupContrast](https://github.com/HobbitLong/SupContrast)
by Yonglong Tian. They retain the BSD 2-Clause license in this directory.

The implementation is integrated into those two modules; a separate copy of the
upstream training scripts is not required.
